story_title: As the assigned Event Coordinator, I want to cancel an event at any stage so it no longer holds arrangements it doesn't need.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an event has not yet been Completed, when the assigned Coordinator cancels it, then the event status changes to Cancelled.
Only the assigned Event Coordinator can cancel the event.
Cancelling an event releases all of its venue bookings, at every venue, and its equipment reservations so they become available for other events.
Pending venue booking requests for the event are withdrawn and no longer appear for Venue Staff to review.
Pending change requests for the event are closed without being applied.
A pending Operational Safety Check for the event is closed and no longer appears for the Safety Officer to review.
Registration for the event is closed, and the event is no longer shown to Attendees as open for registration.
A reason for cancellation can be recorded.
A cancelled event's status cannot be changed to any other status.

open_questions: Written 2026-10-21 before any SPM-37 code (test-first, kayalvizhi24). Every label, dialog, message and badge quoted in the cases that is not already on screen is DECIDED below and is what the developer builds to; check each case against the built screens and run this skill again once the code is written.

DECIDED 2026-10-21 (AC1, which stages): 'not yet Completed' and customer clarification #68 ('any stage') are read as every status that has an assigned Coordinator and is not final: Under review, Approved, Planning, Safety review, Safety approved, Confirmed and Postponed. This adds Under review -> Cancelled to the lifecycle (canTransition() in src/lib/statuses.ts and docs/ConnectSphere_Status_Lifecycle.drawio): today Under review can only go to Approved, Rejected or Withdrawn (TC08). Draft and Submitted have no assigned Coordinator, so nobody can cancel them; Completed, Rejected, Withdrawn and Cancelled are final (TC09, TC11). Confirmed 2026-10-22 (kayalvizhi24): Under review can be cancelled.

DECIDED 2026-10-21 (AC1, AC8 wording): the Overview header gets a 'Cancel event' button for the assigned Coordinator only. It opens a ConfirmDialog (UI_DESIGN.md §7.4 'Event cancelled with live bookings' and §7.5, which require it to name the consequences): title 'Cancel this event?', text '<event title> will be marked Cancelled. This can't be undone.', then 'Cancelling will:' and one line per consequence, in this order: 'Release <venue (code)> on <date, times>' for each Approved booking; 'Withdraw the request for <venue (code)> on <date, times>' for each Pending request; 'Release <reserved> × <equipment>' for each Reserved or Partially fulfilled line; 'Cancel the request for <requested> × <equipment>' for each line not yet reserved; 'Close 1 pending change request' (or 'Close <n> pending change requests'); 'Close the pending safety check'; 'Close registration: <n> registered, <n> on the waiting list' when registration is on. With none of these it reads 'This event has no venue bookings, equipment or registration to release.' Then a 'Reason (optional)' box (up to 2,000 characters, as SPM-67) and the buttons 'Cancel event' and 'Keep event'.

DECIDED 2026-10-21 (AC1, AC8, after cancelling): a green alert 'The event has been cancelled. Its venue bookings and equipment have been released.' (shown even when there was nothing to release, TC07), the 'Cancelled' badge, and on the Overview, for every role that can still open the event, a red alert titled 'This event was cancelled' with the reason, or 'No reason was recorded.' when it was left empty - as the rejected event's alert does. The reason is stored in Event.cancellationReason and the status history row (the route already does this).

DECIDED 2026-10-21 (AC3, AC4): cancelling uses SPM-67's statuses - an Approved booking becomes 'released' and a Pending request 'withdrawn' - with cancelledBy/cancelledAt set and cancellationReason 'Event cancelled: <reason>', or 'Event cancelled.' with no reason, shown on the Venue tab as 'Reason for release: …' / 'Reason for withdrawal: …'. Every equipment line that is not already cancelled becomes 'cancelled' (shown 'Cancelled'), whatever was reserved. All in one transaction with the status change. Rejected, expired, withdrawn and released bookings are left as they are.

DECIDED 2026-10-21 (AC3, temporary filter): src/lib/equipmentAvailability.ts has a TEMPORARY filter (RELEASED_EVENT_STATUSES) that already ignores reservations of cancelled events 'until SPM-37/38'. Built 2026-10-22: 'cancelled' stays in that list although SPM-37 now cancels the lines itself, because events cancelled before SPM-37 (the seeded ones included) still have Reserved lines and the shared database is never reseeded; 'postponed' stays until SPM-38. TC03 passes either way, which is why it checks what another event sees rather than how.

DECIDED 2026-10-21 (AC5): pending change requests become 'withdrawn' - the only closed status EventChangeRequest has besides approved and rejected, which would read as a decision - with reviewedBy/reviewedAt set and reviewNotes 'Closed because the event was cancelled.' Nothing they propose is applied. No screen shows change requests yet (Request Event Change SPM-35, Process Event Change Request SPM-32), so TC05 can only see the dialog line and the unchanged date; the closed status is checked by the automated tests. Confirmed 2026-10-22 (kayalvizhi24): 'withdrawn', no new status.

DECIDED 2026-10-21 (AC5, kayalvizhi24): TC12 checks the closed change request on SPM-32's screen, and is Blocked until SPM-32 is built: each run is recorded as 'Blocked' with Remarks 'SPM-32 not built' (docs/test-cases/README.md), and SPM-37 is not closed while TC12's latest result is Blocked. TC05 can be run now. Its step 5 is a placeholder: when SPM-32 is merged, write in SPM-32's real navigation, labels and status wording, and mark the case Updated.

DECIDED 2026-10-21 (AC6): the pending safety check is closed the way SPM-88 closes one (closeSafetyCheck() in src/lib/safetyCheckClose.ts): status 'closed', decidedBy the Coordinator, decisionNote 'Event cancelled'. An approved check (Safety approved) is closed too, so no approval stays live on a cancelled event; the dialog line is only for a pending one. The event leaves the Safety Officer's Safety Checks list because that list shows Safety review only.

DECIDED 2026-10-21 (AC7): 'registration is closed' means nobody can register (the register route already refuses anything not Confirmed) and the event leaves Browse Events (attendees see Confirmed events only). The registrations themselves are kept unchanged, as SPM-52 decided for a cancelled event ('its history must not change'), and Withdraw is not offered (WITHDRAW_REFUSALS.cancelled already exists). The registration settings (registrationEnabled etc.) are not changed. Customer forum: 'detailed handling of registration withdrawal arising specifically from event changes or cancellation is not required' for Release 1.

DECIDED 2026-10-21 (AC7, AC8, kayalvizhi24): an attendee who holds a place (Registered or on the waiting list) in a cancelled event can still open it, from My Registrations, and sees the 'Cancelled' badge and the red 'This event was cancelled' alert with the reason, with no Register or Withdraw button (TC06). Until now attendees could only open Confirmed events, so they got 'This event doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.' canViewEvent() and eventListWhere() both change for attendees, kept in step, and cancellationReason joins ATTENDEE_EVENT_FIELDS (SPM-53 gives attendees the reason in their cancellation notification, so it is not internal). Browse Events still lists only events the attendee can register for: it already leaves out events whose registration is turned off, and now leaves out any that are not Confirmed too. An attendee who withdrew, or never registered, still cannot open it.

DECIDED 2026-10-21 (notifications, kayalvizhi24): the briefing (§6 'An event is rescheduled, postponed, or cancelled'; Notification System '... or cancellation') asks for cancellation notifications, and Receive Event Notifications (SPM-53, To Do) owns them: 'The Event Organiser who owns the event is notified when it is ... Cancelled. Attendees whose registration is Registered are notified when it is ... Cancelled ... the notification includes the recorded reason.' SPM-53 also says a feature's own notifications live in that feature's story, including 'booking released SPM-67'. So SPM-37 sends only SPM-67's existing 'Venue booking released' notification to every active Venue Staff user, once for each Approved booking the cancellation releases, with the booking's reason ('Event cancelled: <reason>'), as releaseNotification() in src/lib/venueBookingChange.ts words it (TC02). A withdrawn pending request sends nothing, as in SPM-67. The Organiser and attendee notifications are left to SPM-53, which should hook into the cancellation code once it is built. Technical Support and the Safety Officer are not notified: no story asks for it (SPM-88 does not notify on a closed check either).

DECIDED 2026-10-21 (AC9): nothing moves out of Cancelled - canTransition() already has no entry for it, and the server keeps refusing any status change with 'This event is Cancelled and can't be moved to <status>.' (checked by automated tests, since the screen offers no button to try). Every action that is already refused on a closed event stays refused: venue requests, withdraw/release, equipment changes, information edits, coordinator assignment, safety submission and decision.

DECIDED 2026-10-21 (AC2): only the assigned Coordinator sees 'Cancel event' (canSetEventStatus + canTransition, the pattern of canWithdrawEvent()). Another Coordinator, the Event Coordinator Lead, the Organiser and every other role do not (TC10), and the server refuses them with 403 'Your role cannot move an event to "cancelled"' (automated tests). Venue Staff, Technical Support, the Safety Officer and Attendees have no route to the button at all, so no manual case is written for them.
